problem.title: In practice, knowledge is not what gets lost. Context is.
problem.text: Before a meeting, you often need to remember which chart was open, what was discussed before, which periods mattered, where the notes are, and what needs checking.

fragmented.title: Everything lives in different places
fragmented.text: Charts in one tool, notes in another, recordings elsewhere, important dates in messages. Returning to a person quickly becomes difficult.

prep.title: Too much manual searching
prep.text: A simple question such as a transit Uranus conjunction to natal Venus can become several minutes of manual period checking.

trust.title: Continuity is hard to hold
trust.text: When this is not the first meeting, past themes matter. Without one shared space, they are easy to lose.

solution.title: Everything connected to a person and their charts stays within reach.
solution.text: Create a profile, build charts, save notes and recordings, move between related materials, and ask the chat questions from the data. For example: “show transit Uranus conjunctions to natal Venus for the past and next 5 years.” You get the periods in seconds.

calculate.title: Create a chart without extra steps
calculate.text: Date, time, place, timezone, coordinates, and house system move through one clear flow.

read.title: Keep the story nearby
read.text: A profile keeps charts, notes, recorded consultations with transcripts and summaries, and important points together.

prepare.title: Ask the chart data
prepare.text: The chat helps find periods, aspects, and repeating themes that would otherwise take manual searching.

benefits.title: Less sorting through material. More presence in the work itself.

depth.title: The picture is easier to hold

memory.title: Important details stay together

faq.title: A short explanation of how it works

one.q: Is this just a natal chart calculator?
one.a: No. The chart is only the beginning. Steliara also supports people profiles, conversation history, notes, recordings, and quick search through astrological data.

two.q: What can be stored in a profile?
two.a: Charts, notes, conversation recordings, and key moments that help you recover context before the next meeting.

three.a: Ask a question from chart or forecast data. For example, ask for transit Uranus conjunctions to natal Venus for the past and next 5 years and get the periods without manual searching.

four.q: Will it interpret the chart for me?
four.a: No. The point is not to replace your interpretation. The chat helps retrieve data, dates, and links faster.

five.a: Yes. House systems, coordinates, and settings are available for careful astrological work.

six.q: Does it help with long-term practice with the same people?
six.a: Yes. Profiles, notes, recordings, and key moments help keep the story from getting lost.

seven.a: You can remember the person, previous themes, important periods, and current charts faster.

eight.a: Calculations are based on Swiss Ephemeris and modern astronomical standards.

nine.q: Do I need to change my style?
nine.a: No. Steliara should support the way you practice, not impose a ready-made voice.

ten.a: Create the first chart, save a profile, and ask the chat a concrete question about a period or aspect.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and your rights regarding it. We act as the data controller for account data and as a processor for the data you store about the people you work with.
privacy.s1:
1. Data we collect

  • Account data: name, email address, password (stored hashed), and account preferences.
  • Content data: charts, people profiles, birth data, notes, and recordings you create in the Service.
  • Billing data: handled by Stripe (and Link, a Stripe company) as merchant of record. We receive limited transaction details (e.g. plan, status, country, last four digits) but never your full card number.
  • Usage data: log data, device/browser information, audit events, and — where you consent — product-analytics events (pageviews and interactions) used to operate, secure, and improve the Service.
privacy.s2:
2. How we use data

  • To provide, maintain, and improve the Service.
  • To process subscriptions and prevent fraud (via Stripe).
  • To communicate with you about your account, security, and service updates.
  • To comply with legal obligations.
privacy.s3:
3. Legal bases (GDPR)

We process personal data under one or more of: performance of a contract (providing the Service), legitimate interests (securing and improving the Service), legal obligation (tax and accounting), and consent (where required, e.g. optional communications).
privacy.s4:
4. Sharing & sub-processors

Stripe (and Link, a Stripe company) acts as our merchant of record and as an independent controller of payment and transaction data, under Stripe's own Privacy Policy. We also share data with service providers who process data on our behalf under appropriate agreements, including PostHog (product analytics, hosted in the EU), our hosting and database providers, and email delivery providers. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s5:
5. Data retention

We keep account and content data for as long as your account is active. After account closure we delete or anonymize data within a reasonable period, except where retention is required for legal, tax, or security purposes.
privacy.s6:
6. International transfers

Data may be processed in countries outside your own. Where this happens, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.s7:
7. Your rights

Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of your personal data, and you may object to certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details in the Contact section. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.s8:
8. Security

We use industry-standard measures including encryption in transit, hashed passwords, and access controls. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure, but we work to protect your data.
privacy.s9:
9. Cookies

We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and to operate the Service. Stripe may set cookies during checkout to process payments securely. With your consent, we also use analytics cookies (via PostHog) to understand how the Service is used; you can accept or decline these in the consent banner, and analytics are off until you opt in.

refund.heading: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.lead: We want Steliara to be useful for your practice. This policy explains how cancellations and refunds work. Payments are processed by Stripe as Merchant of Record (purchases appear as "Sold through Link"), and refunds are issued through Stripe/Link.
refund.s1:
1. Cancelling your subscription

  • You can cancel at any time from your account settings or via the billing portal link in your Link receipt email (Stripe Managed Payments).
  • When you cancel, your subscription remains active until the end of the current paid period, and it will not renew afterward.
  • You will not be charged again after cancellation.
refund.s2:
2. Refunds

  • If you are within 14 days of your first purchase and have not made substantial use of the Service, you may request a full refund.
  • Renewal charges are generally non-refundable, but if you were charged unexpectedly (for example, you intended to cancel before renewal), contact us and we will review your request fairly.
  • We may issue refunds at our discretion for service issues or billing errors.
  • As the merchant of record, Stripe/Link also lets buyers request a refund through Link support, generally within 60 days of the transaction.
  • Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method by Stripe/Link, typically within 5–10 business days.
refund.s3:
3. Statutory consumer rights

If you are a consumer in the EU/UK, you may have a statutory right of withdrawal within 14 days of purchase. By starting to use a digital service during that period you may agree that the service begins immediately, which can affect this right. Nothing in this policy limits mandatory rights under your local law.
refund.s4:
4. How to request a refund

Email us at the address in the Contact section with your account email and the receipt/order ID from your Stripe/Link confirmation. You can also reach Stripe Managed Payments buyer support via link.com.
